source_adapter_budget_detail: Instantiate accepted TVLQR only to expose its exact 10ms2substep Jacobian and Q/R; do not call full TVLQR.compute when it would introduce uncounted full grids. Reproduce the needed suffix backwards independently using identical last-map DARE and source-derived matrices; store original gains separately.
canonical_operating_tuple_worklist: Two named roles per accepted candidate are not new candidate IDs: six map requests per role, method matched; all domain and parity calls share the300s ceiling. Original gain suffix slots additionally counted before dedup <=960. Record missing roles/maps rather than silently reducing worklist.
